Running it
----------
This is for an Amstrad PCW running CP/M Plus (the 8256, 8512, 9512 or
10 of the family, or an emulator of one).  It needs the 61K the system
leaves a program.

  simcity.dsk     an 80 track, double sided disk image (720 KB, in the
                  extended DSK format) with SIMCITY.COM on it.  The
                  image has no CP/M on it: start the machine from its
                  own CP/M Plus disk, put this one in the second drive
                  (or copy SIMCITY.COM to a disk with PIP), and type
                  B:SIMCITY (or SIMCITY).
  simcity.com     the same program on its own, for copying to a disk of
                  your own.

The game uses the PCW's screen as a 40 by 32 grid of cells, centred, each
a source 8 x 8 picture drawn twice as wide (the PCW's pixels are about
twice as tall as they are wide); the map is drawn in inverse.  It uses
the keyboard through CP/M, and there is no sound.  Cities are saved to
and loaded from CP/M files (names of up to eight letters), on the disk it
was started from.  There is no way out of the game but resetting the
machine.

This has been tried only in MAME (as the PCW 8256 with a second 720 KB
drive): it is untested on a real machine, on the 9512, 10 or 8512, and
the cursor keys have not been tried there.

Keys
----
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (shifted: eight squares)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters, the
                  mini maps
  Esc (EXIT)      leaves a screen and opens the game menu

The cursor keys (as WordStar's ^E ^X ^S ^D) also move the cursor.
